dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, can you help me plan the next part of my trip? I'm going to Chiang Rai.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈhɛlp miː ˈplæn ðə ˈnɛkst ˈpɑːrt əv maɪ ˈtrɪp? aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈraɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. Chiang Rai is in the far north of Thailand, near the border with Myanmar and Laos.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈraɪ ɪz ɪn ðə ˈfɑːr ˈnɔːrθ əv ˈtaɪlænd, ˈnɪr ðə ˈbɔːrdər wɪð ˈmjɑːnmɑːr ənd ˈlaʊs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is there anything interesting on the way from Chiang Mai?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɪntrəstɪŋ ɑːn ðə ˈweɪ frəm ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. There are some nice cafés in the mountains on the way.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðɛr ər sʌm ˈnaɪs kæˈfeɪz ɪn ðə ˈmaʊntənz ɑːn ðə ˈweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. Where should I stay in Chiang Rai?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈwɛr ʃʊd aɪ ˈsteɪ ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈraɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Stay near the night market. Everything will be within walking distance.
dialogue.reading: ˈsteɪ ˈnɪr ðə ˈnaɪt ˌmɑːrkɪt. ˈɛvriθɪŋ wɪl bi wɪˈðɪn ˈwɔːkɪŋ ˈdɪstəns.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And the White Temple? Where is it located?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈwaɪt ˈtɛmpəl? ˈwɛr ɪz ɪt ˈloʊkeɪtɪd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's located just outside the city, about thirteen kilometers away.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈloʊkeɪtɪd ˈdʒʌst ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə ˈsɪti, əˈbaʊt ˌθɜːrˈtiːn kɪˈlɑːmətərz əˈweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'd also like to see some remote villages.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈlaɪk tə ˈsiː sʌm rɪˈmoʊt ˈvɪlɪdʒɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: There are villages in the middle of the mountains, three hours away by car.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ər ˈvɪlɪdʒɪz ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl əv ðə ˈmaʊntənz, ˈθriː ˈaʊərz əˈweɪ baɪ ˈkɑːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And how do I get to Laos from there?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈɡɛt tə ˈlaʊs frəm ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Go to Chiang Khong. It's a small town by the Mekong River, right on the border.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡoʊ tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈkɔːŋ. ɪts ə ˈsmɔːl ˈtaʊn baɪ ðə ˈmeɪkɔːŋ ˈrɪvər, ˈraɪt ɑːn ðə ˈbɔːrdər.
